article.body: A new research paper on AI-driven systems explores how to improve data quality for better AI performance.  The research focuses on the challenges practitioners face when working with AI systems and how to address them.  The research is not a final rule or decision, but it does raise questions about the future of data quality in AI.  No timeline was announced.
